C0758.title: Ctrip Fined RMB 10 Million for Failing to Conduct Data Export Security Assessment
C0758.summary: On June 13, 2026, Ctrip was fined RMB 10 million by the Cyberspace Administration of Shanghai for failing to fulfill data export security assessment requirements and illegally exporting personal information, in violation of the Personal Information Protection Law.
